changes: First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: MrScruff's Slice Loop, ported to elemod by Iced-Cream, with his code unchanged.
SLICE LOOP in the track menu (FUNC + CHRO) fills an empty sound track with sixteen trigs, each locked to the next sixteenth of the sample.
Made for a one-bar loop padded so the bar fills 96/120 of the sample; swing, accents and micro timing then move each slice.
On a track with any trig, a track shorter than 16 steps or the FX track, it refuses and changes nothing.
